mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is persistently below its long-run average for at least 3 consecutive months, investors anticipate future rate cuts, which lowers the real discount rate applied to expected equity cash flows, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 60-day rolling mean during qualifying rate-cut periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp, one-time increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a risk premium compression in equities, reflected as a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher future rates.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in a single month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative relative to the 5-day pre-inflation shock mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeding 200,000 new jobs monthly for two consecutive months signals a labor market strengthening, which reduces recession risk and pushes S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 60-day pre-signaling mean during such labor events (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both HOUST (industrial production) and RSAFS (retail sales) by at least 2% month-over-month indicates weakening aggregate demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < prev AND RSAFS < prev by >=2% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns during such dual declines are not significantly negative relative to the 20-day pre-signaling mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly expansion in INDPRO (industrial production) by at least 3% for three consecutive months suggests improving supply conditions, which reduces near-term supply-side risks and supports a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns during qualifying supply expansions are not statistically higher than the 60-day pre-expansion mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE (unemployment rate) above 5% for two consecutive months indicates a weakening labor market, which increases perceived equity risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns during such unemployment spikes are not significantly negative relative to the 5-day pre-spike mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month moving average of GDPC1 (real GDP) exceeds the 2020–2022 pre-pandemic trend by at least 2%, it signals a return to historical economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns during such GDP expansion signals are not statistically positive relative to the 20-day pre-signal mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in both CPIAUCSL (inflation) and FEDFUNDS (federal funds rate) below their respective 2022 averages for a month indicate a dual disinflationary pressure that reduces equity risk premia and predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2022_mean AND FEDFUNDS < 2022_mean in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns during such dual conditions are not significantly positive relative to the 20-day pre-condition mean (t-test p > 0.05).
